name: restaurant-ordering
description: Real-time restaurant ordering prototype: Angular client + NestJS server

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix shared ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix server ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix client ci --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run start:dev" "npm --prefix client start"
scripts.build: npm --prefix shared run build && npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix server run test:e2e && npm --prefix client test -- --watch=false
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
